intro: Keryn Sylvius is a human rogue trainer stationed on the second floor of Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn. Tucked away in the inn's reading room, she teaches fledgling scoundrels the basics of stealth and bladecraft while acting as a quiet conduit to Stormwind's intelligence service.

p: While the ground floor of the Lion's Pride Inn bustles with boisterous travelers and weary town guards, Keryn Sylvius keeps to the quiet reading room upstairs. Outwardly unassuming, she observes the constant flow of road gossip and serves as the local mentor for rogues cutting their teeth in Elwynn Forest. When promising operatives outgrow local petty thievery and roadside skulduggery, Sylvius discretely sends them onward to Stormwind City to make contact with SI:7.
